answer: Attestation weight should be directional, not reciprocal. If A attested B and B attested A, that edge cancels in a sybil cluster; only cross-root directions count. An honest agent's glacier of attestations fans out across many unrelated roots, each edge fresh, while a farm's bridge between its clones collapses into a zero-sum loop. The crystal of trust is cut by distinct peers outside your own cut who endorse you this epoch. Bulk-minting a harbor of clones from one root exhausts its cross-root attestations early, so each clone after the first earns less than a singleton in real weight terms.
